title: Getting around
summary: Ask the way, buy a ticket

stages.title: Directions & tickets
stages.summary: Ask the way, buy a ticket

sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the train station?
sentences.es: Perdone, ¿dónde está la estación de tren?
sentences.pt: Desculpe, onde fica a estação de comboios?

sentences.en: Is it far from here?
Turn left at the next street.
sentences.es: Gire a la izquierda en la próxima calle.
sentences.pt: Vire à esquerda na próxima rua.

sentences.en: Go straight ahead.
A ticket to the city centre, please.
sentences.es: Un billete al centro, por favor.
sentences.pt: Um bilhete para o centro, por favor.

sentences.en: What time does the bus leave?
sentences.pt: A que horas parte o autocarro?

sentences.en: Which metro line do I take?
sentences.es: ¿Qué línea de metro tengo que coger?
sentences.pt: Que linha de metro tenho de apanhar?

sentences.en: Where do I change lines?
sentences.pt: Onde tenho de mudar de linha?

sentences.en: How do I top up this card?
Does this bus stop at the museum?
Is the next stop the market?
sentences.pt: A próxima paragem é o mercado?

sentences.en: I want to get off here.
To this address, please.
Roughly how much will it cost?
sentences.pt: Quanto vai custar, mais ou menos?

sentences.en: Can you stop here, please?
Please take the fastest route.
sentences.es: Vaya por el camino más rápido, por favor.
sentences.pt: Vá pelo caminho mais rápido, por favor.

sentences.en: Can you open the boot?
Can I have a receipt?
Excuse me, I'm lost.
Can you show me on the map?
sentences.es: ¿Me lo puede enseñar en el mapa?

sentences.en: Is it on this side of the river?
Is it uphill?
How many minutes on foot?
Thank you very much, that's very kind of you.
sentences.es: Muchas gracias, es usted muy amable.

passages.text: Atención, por favor. El tren con destino a Valencia, que tenía prevista su salida a las diez y cuarto, saldrá con veinte minutos de retraso por la vía cuatro. Disculpen las molestias.
passages.en: Attention, please. The train to Valencia, scheduled to leave at quarter past ten, will depart twenty minutes late from platform four. We apologise for the inconvenience.
passages.question: What is happening with the Valencia train?
passages.answer: It leaves twenty minutes late, from platform four.
wrong: It is cancelled. Passengers should take a bus.
It leaves on time from platform twenty.
It now leaves from a different station.

passages.text: Atenção, por favor. O comboio com destino ao Porto, com partida prevista para as dez e um quarto, vai sair com vinte minutos de atraso da linha quatro. Pedimos desculpa pelo incómodo.
passages.en: Attention, please. The train to Porto, scheduled to leave at quarter past ten, will depart twenty minutes late from platform four. We apologise for the inconvenience.
passages.question: What is happening with the Porto train?
passages.answer: It leaves twenty minutes late, from platform four.
wrong: It is cancelled. Passengers should take a bus.
It leaves on time from platform twenty.
It now leaves from a different station.

passages.text: Para ir al centro, coja la línea azul hasta el final y allí cambie a la verde. Son cuatro paradas. La tarjeta se recarga en las máquinas de la estación, con efectivo o con tarjeta.
passages.en: To get to the centre, take the blue line to the end and change to the green one there. It's four stops. You top up the card at the station machines, with cash or card.
passages.question: How do you get to the centre?
passages.answer: Blue line to the end, then change to the green line.
wrong: Blue line, four stops, no change.

passages.text: Para ir ao centro, apanhe a linha azul até ao fim e aí mude para a verde. São quatro paragens. O cartão carrega-se nas máquinas da estação, com dinheiro ou com cartão.
passages.en: To get to the centre, take the blue line to the end and change to the green one there. It's four stops. You top up the card at the station machines, with cash or card.
passages.question: How do you get to the centre?
passages.answer: Blue line to the end, then change to the green line.
wrong: Blue line, four stops, no change.

passages.text: Hasta el centro son unos veinte minutos si no hay tráfico, unos quince euros. Las maletas grandes llevan un pequeño suplemento. Si quiere recibo, se lo imprimo al final.
passages.en: To the centre it's about twenty minutes without traffic, roughly fifteen euros. Big suitcases have a small extra charge. If you want a receipt, I'll print it at the end.
passages.question: What costs extra?

passages.text: Até ao centro são uns vinte minutos se não houver trânsito, uns quinze euros. As malas grandes têm um pequeno suplemento. Se quiser recibo, imprimo-lho no fim.
passages.en: To the centre it's about twenty minutes without traffic, roughly fifteen euros. Big suitcases have a small extra charge. If you want a receipt, I'll print it at the end.
passages.question: What costs extra?

passages.text: Está cerca, pero todo es cuesta arriba. Suba por esta calle hasta la iglesia, gire a la derecha y verá un mirador. El museo está justo detrás, a unos diez minutos.
passages.en: It's close, but it's all uphill. Go up this street to the church, turn right and you'll see a viewpoint. The museum is right behind it, about ten minutes away.
passages.question: Where exactly is the museum?
passages.answer: Right behind the viewpoint, past the church.
wrong: By the river, twenty minutes away.

passages.text: Fica perto, mas é sempre a subir. Suba esta rua até à igreja, vire à direita e vê um miradouro. O museu fica mesmo atrás, a uns dez minutos.
passages.en: It's close, but it's all uphill. Go up this street to the church, turn right and you'll see a viewpoint. The museum is right behind it, about ten minutes away.
passages.question: Where exactly is the museum?
passages.answer: Right behind the viewpoint, past the church.
wrong: By the river, twenty minutes away.
